annotations.title: Hide or unhide a reply on X

description: Hide a reply under the brand’s own X post (hidden:false to unhide) — spam and abuse moderation. A hidden reply is not deleted; it moves behind "View hidden replies". Only works on replies in a conversation the connected account started. Needs the tweet.moderate.write permission: an X connection made before 2026-10-27 must be reconnected once under Settings > Connectors > X (the tool says so without calling X). Costs credits (X bills per API call).

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

replyId.description: the REPLY’s id, or its x.com link
